card.name: Year digits in Quebec history
card.fires_on: Digits inside four-digit years (the 9, 6 or 8 of 1976, 1968, 1980) in text about Quebec politics and history. It also fires weakly on a first name before a Quebec premier's surname.

modes.label: Year digits
modes.description: The second or third digit of a 19xx year in Quebec political history.
modes.example: The Parti Québécois was elected in 1<<9>>76.

modes.label: Premier's first name
modes.description: A first name before the surname of a Quebec premier.
modes.example: governed under<< Robert>> Bourassa and Daniel Johnson, Jr.

card.writes: It pushes against Canada and Canadian words and toward America and USA words, so it dampens Canadian continuations.
card.plain: It fires on year digits in Quebec history passages and steers the model away from saying Canada or Canadian next.
